actualPromptText: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit IMAGE1 only into a clean native-pixel fishing-village map fragment. Preserve the exact existing camera, framing, object count, positions, silhouette, material colors and directional light. Only paint portions actually visible: quiet cyan-blue water; original cropped gray retaining stone at far top if present; warm pier floor with its existing broad diagonal plank divisions; original wood lifting frame and sparse pale ropes; existing slim reddish post/red vertical decoration with its original pale-gold marks; original blue-gray-capped mooring piles and the small dark block at the frame foot. Never complete a cropped object. Add no posts, crossbars, planks, joints, knots, stairs, decorations, new writing, boats or figures. Keep the water intentionally broad, smooth and low contrast with only the original localized shore/contact marks if pictured, never white netting, wave grid, foam streaks or dense texture. Sharp border strips are exact verified neighboring native pixels: preserve their real geometry, far-edge color and shadow, and draw continuous structures across the soft/sharp transition; the strip boundary is not a physical line. IMAGE2 is the PRIMARY confirmed rounded bright clean Q-style hand-painted materials reference, clean substantial forms, controlled clear edges and soft existing cast shadows; no photoreal grain or dense microtexture. Return one opaque native1254x1254 image, no image enlargement, no changed framing, text/UI/frame/collage/blur/oversharpening. Highest available finish.
